title: Luscious Flaky Spanish Gambas Al Ajillo Jjigae
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, featuring flaky pastry and garlic butter, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This galician-inspired recipe is suitable for a buddhist temple-friendly setting.
instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut the dough into 12 equal squares.
Place a piece of the dough on a flat surface, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Place 2-3 pieces of the gambas in the center of the dough, leaving a small amount of space between each piece.
Drizzle 1/2 tablespoon of olive oil over the gambas, then sprinkle with minced garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Fold the dough over the gambas, pressing the edges together to seal the pastry.
Use a fork to crimp the edges of the pastry, then brush the top with unsalted butter.
Place the pastry on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and repeat with the remaining dough and gambas.
Transfer the baking sheet to the preheated wood-fired oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the gambas are cooked through.
Remove the pastrys from the oven and let them cool for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
